create_forum_post: create a forum post with author, title, and content using ForumState.create_post
reply_to_forum_post: reply to an existing forum post by post_id using ForumState.reply_to_post
upvote_or_downvote_post: upvote or downvote a forum post by post_id using ForumState.upvote or ForumState.downvote
parse_and_execute_forum_action: parse a JSON action string and execute post, reply, upvote, or downvote via ForumState.parse_and_execute_action
resolve_putative_events_to_forum_actions: resolve putative events from agent memory into forum actions using ForumResolution.pre_act
